documentation.content: The hourly pd-slack-sync Cloud Run job failed after its retry. Check execution logs in internal-tools-511717/us-central1. Slack membership may be stale. Coverage gaps intentionally preserve membership and do not trigger this failure alert.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "pd-slack-sync" AND resource.labels.location = "us-central1" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
